title: Raadinta Runta ee Khaa'imka ah
intro: Dhul awood iyo sixir hore leh, iska hor imaad weyn ayaa ka dhex dhaca. Dhinac ayaa leh awoodda calaamadaha rabbaaniga ah, halka kan kalena uu isku dayayo inuu la jaanqaado waxyaabaha aan macquulka ahayn. Natiijadu waxay weligeed beddeli doontaa jidka taariikhda. Ma ogaan kartaa aqoonsiga kuwa arkay runta ugu dambeysa oo is-hoosaysiiyay ka hor?
clues: Waxaan aragnay calaamado ka baxsan xeeladaha sixirka.
Dhammaanteen waan sujuudnay, annagoo aan awoodin inaan beeninno runta.
Waxaan aqoonsannay in calaamadahani ay ka yimaadeen Ilaaha runta ah ee keliya
Waxaan ahayn bulshadii ugu horreysay ee si cajiib ah u aqbala diinta
Waxaa naloo ballan qaaday janno inay tahay abaal-marinteenna iimaankeenna awgeed
Xadhkahayagii iyo ushiiyadu waxay noqdeen abeesooyin horteenna, haddana waxaan doorannay inaan is-hoosaysiinno

trial.label: Tijaabo/Dhacdo
options: Kulankii lala yeeshay shaqaalaha Nebi Muuse
Caqabadda ka timid hashii Nebi Saalix
Daadkii weynaa ee nebi lagu soo diray
trial.answer: Kulankii lala yeeshay shaqaalaha Nebi Muuse

outcome.label: Natiijo
options: Burbur ka dhashay dhulgariir lama filaan ah

arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَـٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verse: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses." (20:70)
